abstract: We show that for every unbounded set $A\subset\mathbb R$ and every $0<\varepsilon<1$, there exists a closed set $S\subset\mathbb R$ that has measure at least $1-\varepsilon$ in every unit interval and contains no nontrivial affine copy of $A$. This resolves the Erd\H{o}s similarity problem in the large.
hook: A closed set covers nearly all of the real line yet hides no copy of any unbounded set.
hook_turn: hides no copy of any unbounded set.
summary: For any unbounded set A, the author builds a closed set of measure at least 1 minus epsilon in every unit interval that contains no nontrivial scaled and shifted copy of A. This settles the large-set version of the Erdos similarity problem. The original problem, about sets of positive measure, stays open.
title: A resolution of the Erd\H{o}s similarity problem in the large
